description: An executive producer must approve the final format and broadcast operating plan for a televised opening-night tribute at a film festival.

shared_context.S1: The festival's televised opening-night tribute is scheduled for 9:00 PM in the Grand Lyric Theater.
shared_context.S2: The draft production plan calls for an eight-minute in-person full-band performance with a 90-second song excerpt, a confetti drop, and four stagehands.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final authority to approve or reject the tribute's broadcast operating plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the standard production sign-off, Mara conducts a review with the technical, rights, talent, and safety leads before approving the plan.
shared_context.S5: The sign-off form requires each lead to state the exact final operating requirement for their area and name one concrete update they will enter in the production records.
shared_context.S6: The completed sign-off record must include each lead's final operating requirement and the supporting finding behind it.

PF1.text: During a broadcast line test this afternoon, Dev measured a 180-millisecond latency that makes a live instrumental feed unusable with the house video system; the tested workaround is a pre-recorded instrumental stem with live vocals. Dev has not entered the result in the sign-off packet yet.

PF2.text: Leila's written license confirmation permits only a 45-second excerpt of the tribute recording, forbids any replay after the broadcast, and requires the credit 'Music courtesy of Meridian Songs'; she received the confirmation today but has not updated the rights tracker.

PF3.text: Jon confirmed with the lead performer's agent this morning that the lead can appear only remotely from 8:50 PM to 9:00 PM and that the appearance must be remote rather than in person; the agent's email is still awaiting entry on the talent calendar.

PF4.text: The post-rehearsal safety inspection found that confetti is prohibited beneath the theater's sprinkler array and requires a clear audience aisle measuring exactly 1.5 meters; Sofia received the inspection minutes after the draft plan circulated and has not amended that draft.

acceptance_conditions: The tribute must be approved using the tested broadcast-safe music arrangement.
The performance must use a pre-recorded instrumental stem with live vocals.
The song excerpt must be exactly 45 seconds.
The broadcast must not permit replay after the live airing.
The required Meridian Songs credit must be recorded.
The lead performer must appear remotely during the exact 8:50 PM to 9:00 PM window.
Confetti must be removed from the plan.
The audience aisle must be exactly 1.5 meters clear.
Technical, rights, talent, and safety follow-up commitments must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['music_source'] == 'pre-recorded instrumental stem with live vocals'
content_checks.C7: decisions['appearance_window'] in ['8:50 PM to 9:00 PM', '8:50-9:00 PM', '8:50 PM-9:00 PM']
content_checks.C8: decisions['special_effect'] in ['none', 'no confetti', 'no confetti drop', 'confetti drop removed', 'confetti drop eliminated', 'none (confetti removed)', 'none (confetti drop removed)', 'none (confetti drop eliminated)', 'no confetti beneath sprinkler array']
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'Dev' and '180-millisecond' in c['detail'] and 'pre-recorded instrumental stem' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(c['target'] == 'Leila' and ('license' in c['detail'] or 'rights tracker' in c['detail'] or 'rights sign-off' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C12: any(c['target'] == 'Jon' and ('agent' in c['detail'] or 'email' in c['detail']) and 'talent calendar' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C13: any(c['target'] == 'Sofia' and 'confetti' in c['detail'] and '1.5-meter' in c['detail'] and ('plan' in c['detail'] or 'safety' in c['detail'] or 'production records' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 180-millisecond latency changes the music source from a live full-band feed to a pre-recorded instrumental stem with live vocals and creates the corresponding technical update.
The license changes the excerpt from 90 seconds to exactly 45 seconds, disables replay, fixes the credit wording, and requires a rights-tracker update.
The agent confirmation changes the lead's appearance from the planned in-person performance to a remote appearance specifically from 8:50 PM to 9:00 PM and requires a talent-calendar update.
The safety inspection changes the effect from a confetti drop to no confetti, fixes the audience layout at exactly 1.5 meters of clear aisle, and requires a safety-plan update.
